description: This header file provides internal helper functions and constants for the Starboard Accessibility API, including color matching, font size, and opacity calculations, as well as color definitions and utility functions.

methods.name: GetClosestCaptionColorRGB
methods.description: Returns the closest caption color enum based on RGB input by calculating the minimal color distance.

methods.name: GetClosestCaptionColor
methods.description: Converts a color integer to the closest caption color enum.

methods.name: FindClosestReferenceValue
methods.description: Finds the reference value closest to the given value from an array of reference values.

methods.name: GetClosestFontSizePercentage
methods.description: Returns the closest font size percentage enum based on input percentage.

methods.name: GetClosestOpacity
methods.description: Returns the closest opacity percentage enum based on input opacity.
